US Secretary of State visits Latin America to boost ties

US Secretary of State Antony Blinken is visiting Colombia, Ecuador, and Peru to strengthen economic and security cooperation with right-wing leaders. The trip aims to enhance US counter-drug priorities and military cooperation with Bogota. Discussions also include China's influence, trade deals, and restoring ties with Colombia. The visit follows a period where support for US figures among Venezuelans was impacted by a US oil deal.
